integrity: All scientific proofs and reproducibility checks are supplied; same-model review only, no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite real equally spaced chains, Euclidean isotonic regression and first-difference lp seminorm only. title: Sharp Sobolev-exponent growth of isotonic regression sensitivity
